the hysteresis observed in bottom-gate pm-Si:H TFTs is due to charge injection from the channel and the gate electrode.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the hysteresis observed in wide-channel TFTs can be suppressed using narrow-channel TFTs.
the hysteresis observed in the transfer curve of wide channel TFT is mainly due to the charge trapping in the gate dielectrics.

the hysteresis can be eliminated in wide channel TFTs by using a narrow source and drain region, and the hystereses observed in narrow channel TFTs can be eliminated by increasing the width of the gate electrode.
